s: I would buy a full bottle of this but don't love it enough to justify the price. It's a bit to youthful for me, but really pretty. - lychee and rhubarb strong at the opening and maybe even a bit of alcohol, but settles into a sweet jammy rose. I do like it better than the exclusif as it's more subtle, ,but I wish I could find the nutmeg, vanilla and cashmeran. ... Light, fresh and beautiful. I love the lychee note in this. I prefer the Delina exclusif version but this one is great for summer.
